Adam first inquired about LiHua's availability for the air-conditioner installation around 13:00 on August 3, 2026, and LiHua suggested that LiHua was usually free in the afternoon, proposing that they schedule it for that time due to LiHua's work at The Lighthouse Cafe. Adam agreed to check with the contractor and get back to LiHua.

Subsequently, on August 12, 2026, at 11:00, Adam reminded LiHua that the contractor team was scheduled to install the AC in the basement at 6 PM that day. This indicates that within a week of the initial conversation about the air-conditioner installation, Adam had organized a reminder for LiHua about the exact time and date of the contractor's visit.

To summarize, it took less than a week from Adam's initial inquiry about a suitable installation time for LiHua to arrange for the contractor team's visit at 6 PM on August 12, 2026. Adam was proactive in coordinating the logistics and confirming the installation schedule with LiHua.
